currentTransformation.promise: One coherent climb: monumental original 3D environments, grounded grip-to-landing motion, tactical visible decisions, understandable guardian danger and opt-in terrain-aware spatial sound, with a minimal in-game HUD.
currentTransformation.nextDecision: Source-pinned desktop and phone footage still shows small climbers, weak physical contact and limited guardian action readability. Candidate CI software-render submissions are slower in the inspected ascent/guardian samples; these are NOT hardware FPS. Complete visible outcome/restart, independent LOOKS/FEELS/PLAYS preferences and supported-device frame times remain unverified.
currentTransformation.rejectedMicroMilestones: A green CI run, an isolated pose fix, a prettier screenshot or an extra UI icon never counts as a Gauntlet win.
